title: CobbleMania Airdrops
description: A fully customizable airdrop system for Cobblemon that rewards players with items or Pokémon, easily configured via in-game commands.
body:
🪂 CobbleMania Airdrops
CobbleMania Airdrops is a powerful and highly versatile utility mod designed for Cobblemon servers and single-player worlds. It allows you to create, manage, and place supply drops that can reward players with anything from basic survival gear to rare Pokémon.

🌟 Main Features
Versatile Rewards: Configure your drops to include standard items, rare Cobblemon loot, or even direct Pokémon rewards.

Global Placement: You can manually place these airdrops anywhere in the world to create exploration points or server-wide events.

Full Customization: Tailor every aspect of the drop to fit your server's economy and difficulty level.

🛠️ Configuration & Management
The mod features an intuitive in-game management system:

/drops owner Command: This is the primary tool for admins. It opens a specialized menu where you can configure loot tables, edit drop settings, and manage existing airdrops in real-time without needing to restart the game.

🚀 Perfect for Servers
This mod was built to enhance the player experience by providing extra motivation for exploration and rewarding active community members. Whether you're hosting a treasure hunt or a competitive loot rush, CobbleMania Airdrops is the ideal tool for the job.

Note: This mod is optimized for performance and requires the Cobblemon mod to be installed as a dependency.
